name: Dessert House / Sweet Shop
description: Tailored for dedicated dessert venues, dessert parlors, and late-night sweet lounges delivering high-energy sit-down experiences. Designed around freshly made-to-order Belgian and bubble waffles, artisan crêpes, hot churros, chocolate fondue sets, molten lava cakes, sundaes, loaded milkshakes, and celebration dessert platters.

sections.name: Waffles
sections.description: Freshly baked-to-order Belgian waffles, Hong Kong bubble egg waffles, and chocolate-dipped waffle sticks. As the cornerstone of the dessert house, this section delivers hot, golden-crisp waffle bases paired with an extensive multi-tier customization bar featuring fresh orchard fruits, warm chocolate drizzles, gelato scoops, chantilly cream, and toasted nuts.

subSections.name: Belgian Waffles
subSections.description: Authentic Brussels-style deep-pocketed waffles with crisp airy texture and pearl-sugar Liege yeast waffles baked to caramelized perfection.

subSections.name: Bubble Waffles
subSections.description: Signature Hong Kong style egg puff waffles featuring crispy spherical bubbles and custardy centers, served flat on platters or rolled into loaded dessert cones.

subSections.name: Waffle Sticks
subSections.description: Portable skewer-mounted waffle pops dipped in warm Belgian chocolate and coated in crushed biscuits, confections, and nuts for easy table sharing.

choices.label: Classic Golden Crisp (Balanced crisp exterior & fluffy interior)
Extra Crispy (Darker bake for maximum crunch)

sections.name: Crêpes
sections.description: Paper-thin French sweet crêpes and traditional savory galettes spun to order on circular cast-iron billig griddles. This section offers customers an authentic European crêperie experience with customizable warm spreads, fresh berries, fruit compotes, and artisan savory fillings for guests seeking savory balance.

subSections.name: Sweet Crêpes
subSections.description: Delicately folded thin sweet crêpes filled with rich chocolate spreads, seasonal berries, sweet creams, and finished with warm drizzles.

subSections.name: Savory Crêpes
subSections.description: Savory folded crêpes and buckwheat galettes filled with artisanal cheeses, cured meats, sautéed mushrooms, and fresh herbs to satisfy savory palates.

choices.label: Fresh Lemon Juice & Golden Cane Sugar
Scoop of Vanilla Bean Ice Cream
Side Cup of Fresh Mixed Berries

sections.name: Churros
sections.description: Handcrafted Spanish choux-pastry dough extruded and deep-fried fresh to order until crisp and golden. Essential for casual grazing and table sharing, this section offers elongated classic flutes, filled churros, and bite-sized churro nuggets served with warm dipping pots of melted Belgian chocolate, dulce de leche, and artisan sauces.

subSections.name: Classic Churros
subSections.description: Traditional elongated ridged Spanish churros, deeply crunchy outside and soft inside, dusted in cinnamon sugar or confectioner's sugar.

subSections.name: Filled Churros
subSections.description: Large hollow-center churros generously injected with warm dulce de leche, chocolate ganache, Bavarian custard, or Nutella.

subSections.name: Churro Bites
subSections.description: Poppable bite-sized churro nuggets served in sharing cups, cones, or buckets, perfect for effortless dipping and snacking.

choices.label: Regular Portion (4 Long Churros or 8 Bites)
Sharing Basket (8 Long Churros or 16 Bites)
Party Box (16 Long Churros or 32 Bites)
Extra Dulce de Leche Dip Pot

sections.name: Pancakes & French Toast
sections.description: Indulgent griddle favorites including towering buttermilk pancake stacks, viral jiggly Japanese soufflé pancakes, and golden brioche French toast. Designed for decadent brunch and dessert cravings, this section offers layered textures, rich syrups, whipped compound butters, and fresh fruit garnishes.

subSections.name: Stack Pancakes
subSections.description: Multi-tier American-style buttermilk pancake stacks layered with butter, warm chocolate ganache, maple syrup, and sweet garnishes.

subSections.name: Japanese Soufflé Pancakes
subSections.description: Ultra-airy, delicate meringue-whipped soufflé pancakes slow-cooked on griddles for an iconic jiggly, cloud-like melt-in-the-mouth texture.

subSections.name: French Toast
subSections.description: Thick-cut artisanal brioche or challah loaf soaked in vanilla-cinnamon egg custard, pan-caramelized in butter, and lavishly garnished.

choices.label: Double Stack (2 Pancakes / 2 Thick Brioche Slices)
Triple Stack (3 Pancakes / 3 Thick Brioche Slices)

sections.name: Chocolate Fondue & Sharing
sections.description: Interactive tabletop chocolate fondue service and loaded dipping platters designed for dates, couples, and groups. Featuring tea-light heated ceramic fondue pots filled with liquid Belgian chocolate, accompanied by bamboo skewers and tiered platters of fresh fruit, warm pastries, marshmallows, and confections.

subSections.name: Chocolate Fondue Sets
subSections.description: Tabletop heated ceramic pots filled with molten Belgian chocolate, served with skewers and curated dipping treats for 2 or more guests.

subSections.name: Fruit & Dipping Platters
subSections.description: Generous tiered sharing boards loaded with seasonal orchard berries, pastry bites, brownie cubes, and sweet dippers.

choices.label: Creamy Belgian White Chocolate (Sweet vanilla cocoa butter)
Marble Swirl (Half milk chocolate, half white chocolate)
Ruby Chocolate (Naturally pink with berry acidity)
Duo Set for 2 Guests (1 Chocolate Pot + Standard Dipper Platter)
Grande Set for 3 to 4 Guests (2 Chocolate Pots + Large Dipper Platter)
Royale Banquet for 5 to 6 Guests (3 Chocolate Pots + Deluxe Multi-Tier Platter)

sections.name: Cakes & Pastries
sections.description: Refrigerated showcase bakes, individual fine patisserie, and rich cake slices. This section caters to guests seeking European entremets, towering multi-layered celebration cakes, basque cheesecakes, and signature desserts for sit-down dining or takeaway indulgence.

subSections.name: Individual Pastries
subSections.description: Artisanal single-portion patisserie pieces including glazed fruit tarts, chocolate eclairs, Paris-Brest choux, and French macarons.

subSections.name: Cake Slices
subSections.description: Generous cut slices of Basque burnt cheesecake, multi-layer chocolate fudge cake, red velvet, honey mille-crêpe, and tiramisu.

subSections.name: Specialty Desserts
subSections.description: Signature house creations, deconstructed dessert jars, crisp layered mille-feuille, pavlovas, and seasonal confection cups.

choices.label: Room Temperature (Allowed to rest for optimal aromatic flavor)
Gently Warmed (For chocolate fudge and sponge slices)
Side Pitcher of Warm Pouring Vanilla Custard
Side Pitcher of Warm Belgian Dark Chocolate
Takeaway Pastry Gift Box with Carrier

sections.name: Ice Cream & Frozen
sections.description: Small-batch artisanal gelato, gourmet dairy ice creams, vegan fruit sorbets, and nostalgic sundae creations. Functioning both as standalone frozen treats and as decadent sides for hot waffles and brownies, this section supports scoop counting, flavor selections, cones, cups, and espresso affogatos.

subSections.name: Scoops & Cups
subSections.description: Pure artisanal gelato and dairy-free fruit sorbets scooped to order in cups or crisp handcrafted waffle cones.

subSections.name: Sundaes
subSections.description: Elaborate multi-scoop sundae glasses layered with hot fudge, salted caramel, fruit compotes, crushed nuts, whipped cream, and wafer biscuits.

subSections.name: Affogato
subSections.description: Classic Italian dessert pairing a dense scoop of cold gelato drowned with a freshly pulled shot of hot espresso, matcha, or liquid chocolate.

choices.label: Chocolate Dipped Cone with Rainbow Sprinkles

sections.name: Hot Desserts
sections.description: Oven-baked and steamed comforting desserts served piping hot straight from the kitchen. Featuring molten lava cakes with liquid flowing centers, traditional steamed puddings soaked in butterscotch, warm skillet bakes, and bubbling fruit pies paired with cold vanilla ice cream or warm pouring custard.

subSections.name: Lava Cakes
subSections.description: Individual molten center chocolate and caramel cakes that break open to reveal a luscious flowing molten heart.

subSections.name: Puddings & Soufflés
subSections.description: Warm sticky date and toffee puddings, brioche bread and butter puddings, and freshly risen airy sweet soufflés.

subSections.name: Warm Pies
subSections.description: Skillet fruit crumbles, deep-dish spiced cinnamon apple pies, bourbon pecan tarts, and bubbling berry cobblers.

choices.label: Madagascar Vanilla Bean Gelato (Hot & Cold Contrast)
Pitcher of Warm Pouring Vanilla Custard
Freshly Baked to Order (Served piping hot, approx. 10-12 min bake time)

sections.name: Beverages
sections.description: Specialty dessert drinks, thick European hot chocolates, loaded gourmet milkshakes, espresso beverages, and refreshing cold drinks. Crafted both to serve as independent sweet indulgences (like freakshakes and thick drinking chocolate) and as balancing counterparts (like double espresso and cleansing herbal teas) to sweet dishes.

subSections.name: Hot Chocolate & Specialty Drinks
subSections.description: Thick European-style drinking chocolate melted with cream, gourmet flavored cocoas, matcha lattes, and spiced chai.

subSections.name: Milkshakes & Blended
subSections.description: Thick gelato milkshakes, over-the-top loaded freakshakes crowned with waffles and brownies, blended frappes, and fruit smoothies.

subSections.name: Coffee & Tea
subSections.description: Espresso-based barista coffees, flat whites, iced cold brews, and loose-leaf black, herbal, and green teas to cleanse the palate.

subSections.name: Cold Drinks
subSections.description: House-crafted sparkling fruit lemonades, iced tea coolers, Italian cream sodas, artisan sodas, and sparkling mineral water.

choices.label: Jumbo Freakshake Mug (24 oz Loaded Format)

sections.name: Party & Sharing Sets
sections.description: High-impact large-format dessert boards, grand group fondue setups, and celebration party packages for groups, birthdays, and catered events. Designed to simplify multi-guest ordering and banquet preparations with predetermined guest counts and scheduled pre-order lead times.

subSections.name: Dessert Platters
subSections.description: Abundant grazing platters featuring bite-sized waffles, churro nuggets, brownie squares, fresh fruit skewers, and dipping sauce pots.

subSections.name: Group Fondues
subSections.description: Grand-scale multi-chocolate fondue warmers served with revolving carousel trays of dippers for large parties and celebratory tables.

subSections.name: Party Pre-Orders
subSections.description: Custom party dessert boxes, towering celebration displays, and dessert feast boxes requiring advance booking and scheduled pickup or table reservation.

timeBehavior.note: Party platters and group fondue setups are prepared fresh to order. Large party pre-orders require 24-hour advance reservation.

sections.name: Seasonal & Limited
sections.description: Rotating seasonal dessert specials, festive holiday creations, and limited-run harvest treats. Keeps the dessert menu dynamic and encourages repeat visits with offerings like summer berry waffle stacks, autumn spiced pumpkin bakes, winter campfire s'mores fondues, and festive holiday desserts.

subSections.name: Seasonal Fruit Features
subSections.description: Spring and summer specials highlighting fresh local harvests including wild strawberry waffle towers, mango crêpes, and peach melba sundaes.

subSections.name: Autumn & Winter Warmers
subSections.description: Cozy seasonal comfort desserts including pumpkin spiced soufflé pancakes, gingerbread lava cakes, hot spiced cider, and campfire s'mores fondues.

subSections.name: Holiday & Festivity Editions
subSections.description: Themed creations for Valentine's Day, Halloween, Christmas, and festive celebrations featuring themed colors, garnishes, and festive presentation.

choices.label: Crushed Candy Cane & Peppermint Bark Curls

systemFeatures.name: Interactive Topping & Sauce Builder
systemFeatures.description: Powers interactive multi-tier customizers for waffles, crêpes, pancakes, churros, sundaes, and fondue sets with live pricing and visual topping combinations.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Tagging
systemFeatures.description: Displays clear visual allergen flags (dairy, gluten, nuts, peanuts, eggs, soy) and dietary lifestyle tags (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free friendly, halal-friendly) across sweet items and drinks.

systemFeatures.name: Real-Time Inventory & Freshness Badges
systemFeatures.description: Displays real-time availability tags including 'Sold Out Today' for daily fresh pastries, 'Freshly Baked to Order' for waffles and lava cakes, and low-stock indicators.

systemFeatures.name: Advance Party & Platter Pre-Order
systemFeatures.description: Enables advance ordering, lead-time tracking, and scheduled pickup or table reservation dates for large dessert platters, group fondue kits, and celebration party orders.
